summary: High Tide Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting it has secured credit approval for a new C$40 million senior secured credit facility from Bank of Montreal. The facility comprises a C$25 million committed revolving facility with a three-year maturity and a C$15 million delayed draw term loan. The proceeds will refinance existing debt, including a loan from connectFirst and second-lien debentures. Closing is subject to customary conditions and expected within 30 days. This is a routine financing update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
